analysis.summary: Management discussed Fonebox Retail Limited's H1 FY 2024-25 financial results, highlighting a 17% revenue increase and an 11% growth in PAT compared to H1 of the previous year. They detailed their expansion plans in Maharashtra and Gujarat, noting the active store count and franchise versus company-owned store split. Additionally, management provided guidance for the current financial year and FY 2026, while explaining their inventory management using Power BI and financing partnerships. Fonebox Retail Limited reported its investor presentation for the half year ended September 30, 2024, highlighting operational expansion, active stores, and financial performance including revenue from operations and profit after tax. Management noted that the Indian smartphone retail market was valued at approximately $45 billion in 2024 and outlined growth drivers such as increasing smartphone adoption, 5G rollout, and affordable device pricing.

guidance.claim: The revenue target for FY25 is 400 plus crores without tax, and approximately 464 to 470 crores with tax.
guidance.quote: Revenue target for this year FY. 25. Our revenue target is 400 plus at least. If we calculate with tax it will nearly around so it is without tax. We are seeing on the balance sheet part on the Tax. With the tax it will lead around 464-470 crore.

demand_outlook.claim: Physical retail has been increasing every day over the last six quarters compared to online versus physical retail being equivalent earlier.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, a physical retail is being increasing since last 2 years. If we see quarter on quarter data online versus physical retail as near to equivalent before 6 quarters. But since last 6 quarter, if we see the data physical retail is being increasing every day.

demand_outlook.claim: Online sales have been decreasing over the last six quarters due to profit pressures on e-commerce companies.
demand_outlook.quote: As I told earlier, that since last 6 quarter this, online sales is kept on decreasing, there is a reason behind it.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is fueled by increasing smartphone adoption, rollout of 5G technology, affordable device pricing, and a rising base of young consumers.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth is fueled by: • Increasing smartphone adoption • Rollout of 5G technology • Affordable device pricing • A rising base of young, tech-savvy consumers

capex_expansion.claim: Future store openings will maintain a ratio of 3 company-owned (COCO) to 7 franchisee-owned (FOCO) stores.
capex_expansion.quote: 3 will be company owned, and 7 will be Franchisee. Own company operated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a definitive Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement for the acquisition of 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited for a total consideration of ₹25.74 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequent to the financial year ended March 31, 2026, and prior to the approval of the Board’s Report for FY 2025-26 by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 19, 2026, the Company entered into a definitive Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement (“SSPA”) dated May 22, 2026, for the acquisition of 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited.

margins_costs.claim: Management successfully negotiated margin increases with three brands namely Samsung, Vivo, and Xiaomi for the year.
margins_costs.quote: I'm seeing on the some of the brands like Samsung, Vivo and Xiaomi. We are successful this year to increment our margin, and for rest of the brands, we are working closely to increase our margin.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent ₹8.95 Lakh on corporate social responsibility activities against the CSR obligation of ₹8.84 Lakh.
capital_allocation.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company spent ₹8.95 Lakh on CSR activities against the CSR obligation of ₹8.84 Lakh.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to enhance shareholder value and sustain growth momentum through operational performance, effective cost management, and domestic marketing initiatives.
management_commitments.quote: To further enhance shareholder value and sustain the growth momentum, the Company has focused on strengthening its operational performance through effective cost management and enhanced domestic marketing initiatives.
